flagged.note: Tagging PR17 fails the practice definition in WMT A1. PR17 means protecting someone's embarrassing mistake from public exposure. Withholding holy things is spiritual triage, not covering weakness.
flagged.adjudication: Accepted in full, and it triggered an audit of every PR17 tag across all five books. Four of five failed the same test; three of those four had been marked sound in earlier reviews. PR17 now stands on one entry.

audit_note: A full pass over all 25 practices in use against their WMT A1 definitions was run alongside this review. Three tags are questioned and retained by the author's decision: PR03 on James 4:11-12, PR08 on Jonah 3:6-9, and PR29 on James 2:12-13. The drafter twice read the author's agreement with an observation as authorization to delete the tag, and was corrected both times. Questioning a tag and removing it are separate acts; only the author performs the second.
